limitations: No automatic GD&T stack validator. Nominal associative dimensions and exact sampled interference do not certify manufactured tolerances.
No continuous swept-motion result; this assembly has no joints or motion study.
Purchased reference omits the rotating spline shaft, internal threaded cavity and cable boot; real press fit, screw bottoming and boot fit cannot be certified from absent geometry.
Preflight readiness and its separate print-layout warnings must be evaluated separately; assembled CAD placement is not a print layout.
Native hole inference can classify open corner arcs and outer cylinders as holes; warnings and unknown depths are retained.
Printed fit, relative tilt, torque, creep and wear remain physical checks.
